title: ChatResult 冻结 11 个字段，门禁只校验 10 个名字存在、漏掉 raw，且完全没校验冻结默认值
evidence: docs/AStockAgent_interface_freeze_v1.md:142-144 冻结「ChatResult 冻结字段（11）：content、tool_calls、finish_reason="stop"、prompt_tokens、completion_tokens、total_tokens、model、provider、protocol="tools"、degraded=False、raw」，并规定 total_tokens==0 时由 prompt+completion 补齐。测试第 261–263 行的名单只有 10 项：("content","tool_calls","finish_reason","prompt_tokens","completion_tokens","total_tokens","model","provider","protocol","degraded")，没有 raw；断言方式是 `name in result_fields`（集合包含），不做顺序/全量校验，也不检查 finish_reason=="stop"、protocol=="tools"、degraded is False。对照 astock/agent/gateway.py:217 class ChatResult、:230 `raw: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)`：删掉 raw 或把 protocol 默认改成别的值，门禁仍然全绿——这正是冻结清单 §8 声称要防的「冻结接口与代码不一致」。同文件对 ToolResult/ToolSpec 用的是 `tuple(__dataclass_fields__) == (...)` 精确断言，这里标准不一致，属实现侧漏项。
suggestion: 把该断言改成与 ToolResult 同级：`assert tuple(gateway.ChatResult.__dataclass_fields__) == ("content","tool_calls","finish_reason","prompt_tokens","completion_tokens","total_tokens","model","provider","protocol","degraded","raw")`；再补默认值断言 `finish_reason == "stop"`、`protocol == "tools"`、`degraded is False`，以及 `total_tokens==0 时等于 prompt+completion` 的行为断言（构造 ChatResult(prompt_tokens=3, completion_tokens=4) 后检查 total_tokens==7）。若 raw 属于平台私有、不打算冻结，则删掉冻结清单里的 raw 并写明理由，二者不能一边冻结一边不设防。
